ISSUES
The issues before the Board are the January 1, 2008,1 fair market values ofwhat was
originally an apartment complex, currently in the process ofbeing converted to condominium
ownership, located at 31420 106th Place SE in Auburn, Washington.
FACTS AND CONTENTIONS
Theunits to be analyzed are all contained within a development having relatively high
density aggregate physical characteristics. There are atotal of19 three- and twos-tory, wood-
frame structures built in 1982. The development has atotal of 132 units, o(nly 87 are under
appeal).T he total gross living areais 191,079 square feet. The averageunit size ofthe 132-unit
complex is approximately 14,48 square feet. There are three unit configurations: two-story
townhouse, three-story townhouse, and flats. The Assessor gives the subjectbuildings "average"
construction quality ratings; assigned condition ratings are "fair"a nd "average."P arking
accommodations include 222 parking spaces: 40 garage spaces, 73 carport spaces, and 109 open
spaces. The 454,7372 square foot (1a0c4.re4)-lo t is zoned R4,3 a zoning classification that
permits the current use. The overall site incurs topographic impacts ofa relatively undefined
nature.
Due to the condominium4 ownership status, each unit is assigned a separate parcel
number. In the hearing discussion that follows, they will be identified and addressed separately
by minors number for ease ofreference.
